messages.name: AS indication about release of RRC connection
AS indication about bearer establishment for user plane

notes: Security protected NAS message: this could be e.g. a SECURITY MODE COMMAND, SERVICE ACCEPT, or ESM DATA TRANSPORT message.

AS indications (indications from lower layers) are results of procedures triggered by MME in service request procedure. Triggered procedures could be e.g. an RRC connection release procedure or RRC connection reconfiguration procedure (see 3GPP TS 36.331 [22]).
Figure shows four OR-separated scenarios for service request handling
Timer T3417 is started when UE sends CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST and stopped upon receiving response
